text_block_list.name: Sweep & Biko
text_block_list.text: Tail fortune-telling?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ye~p! It's super trendy right now—you can do love fortunes using tail hair♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Does a love fortune mean... um...
you can find out who someone likes...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Something waaaay cooler. Get this—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You'll find out who your destined partner is!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-You can actually
figure that out...?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! I can just tell~!
For example, if it's Flower-chan's tail—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It says, "You will meet a gentle partner who cherishes their family"~☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
She's so kind and cares so much about her family...
I-I see...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep-chan's is...
a 'slightly flashy partner'!
That's what it says~!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
F-Flashy!?
Is it really...!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on, tell me more about that fortune-telling!
I wanna try it too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Sure thing~!
Umm, look at this chart like this, see—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —*Ahem* Well then, I'll reveal Biko's fated partner.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine, don't worry about me!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Really? Aren't you even a little curious?
I mean, this is your destined partner, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
B-But, I mean, I just don't get it...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Please, just for a little bit!
I swear I'll guess it right~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!
I told you it's fineee!
